"GO-SLOW" STRIKE OF WORKERS AT THE HUNG SHIN IRON FOUNDRY

The Hung Shin Iron Foundry (项昌兴翻沙廠)
corner of Y'ra andailer Roads, was established by ong
Yi Sin (项意心) in 1912 and has a branch at the corner of
Hung Ho Sin Road and Lan San Road, Chapei.
The Hung Shin Thong Iron Foundry has a foundry
department, a carpentering department, a brass-smith
department and other departments and employs some 100 hands.
In June the management drew up certain rules
governing the service of workers, but the agreement created
much dissatisfaction among the workers. Consequently,
25 hands of the foundry department went on a "go-slow" strike.
The management submitted a petition to the
Bureau of Social Affairs asking for permission to dismiss
Zung Yung Ling (陳永林) and five other workers.
The Bureau of Social Affairs convened
representatives of two parties to a mediation meeting, but
the meeting had no result.
As a protest against the dismissal of Zung Yung
Ling and five others, the remaining workers in both the
main and branch foundries suspended operations yesterday
morning. Representatives were detailed to make an appeal
to the Bureau of Social Affairs with a request that the
dismissed workers be reinstated immediately and that the
rules governing the service of workers be amended.
The callers were received by an official of the
mediation section of the Bureau, who informed them that the
dismissal of these workers had been approved by the Bureau
because they had resorted to strike, sabotage and assault.
Enquiries made by our reporter show that the
strikers of the branch foundry will probably resume work
to-day.

项昌兴翻沙厂工人“怠工”罢工

项昌兴翻沙厂（Hung Shin Iron Foundry）位于亿利路（Y'ra Road）与爱礼路（ailer Road，原文不清，音译）转角，由项意心（ong Yi Sin，原文拼写有误，应为Wong或Ong）于1912年创立，并在闸北洪厚信路（Hung Ho Sin Road，音译）与兰山路（Lan San Road，音译）转角设有分厂。
项昌通翻沙厂（Hung Shin Thong Iron Foundry）设有铸造部、木工部、铜匠部等部门，雇佣工人约100名。
六月间，资方制定了一些关于工人服务的规章，但该协议在工人中引起极大不满。因此，铸造部的25名工人进行了“怠工”罢工。
资方向社会局提交请愿书，请求批准开除陈永林（Zung Yung Ling，此处中文名依后文及常见译法修正为曾永林或保留音译，但前文汉字已给陈永林，此处依后文档案统一性需注意，下文档案显示为曾永林/董士岳等，此处新闻译文暂按原文汉字“陈永林”翻译，但需注意后续档案差异）及其他五名工人。
社会局召集双方代表举行调解会议，但会议没有结果。
为抗议开除陈永林（Zung Yung Ling）及其他五人，总厂和分厂的其余工人于昨天上午停止作业。他们派出代表向社会局呼吁，要求立即复职被开除的工人，并修改工人服务规章。
来访者受到社会局调解科一名官员的接见，该官员告知他们，由于这些工人采取罢工、破坏和袭击行为，社会局已批准开除他们。
本报记者调查显示，分厂的罢工工人可能会于今日复工。

Shanghai Tug and Lighter Company - unrest among lightermen

Unrest now exists among the 500 lightermen of the
Shanghai Tug and Lighter Company, 2-3 Quai de France, as
a result of the decision of the management to reduce the
number of lighters in operation by fifteen with effect from
July 1, and reduce the wages of the crew of the lighters
affected by one half.

Ten committee members of the Shanghai Tug and Lighter
Boatmen's Union held a meeting in their office, 117 Foh
Yeu Road, City, at 10 a.m. June 25, and passed the
following resolutions :-

1) That two representatives be detailed to negotiate with
the management of the Company to withdraw from
commission 10 lighters instead of 15.

2) That should the negotiations result in failure, a
further meeting be convened.

Hong Shing Chong Iron Foundry - labour situation

The 19 workers of the Hong Shing Chong ( 鴻 興 昌 )
Iron Foundry, 150 Urga Road, who suspended operations on
June 17 as a protest against the introduction by the
management of new regulations stipulating an increase in
the working hours and the infliction of punishment on
workers for neglect of duty (vide I.R.20/6/36), are still
out this morning, June 26.

The management of the foundry was instructed on June
25 by the Bureau of Social Affairs to attend a meeting at
the Bureau at 10 a.m. June 26, to discuss the situation.

上海拖轮驳船公司 - 驳船工人中的不安情绪

上海拖轮驳船公司（Shanghai Tug and Lighter Company，地址：法租界外滩2-3号）的500名驳船工人中目前存在不安情绪，原因是资方决定自7月1日起减少15艘运营驳船，并将受影响驳船船员的工资减半。

上海拖轮驳船工会的十名委员于6月25日上午10时在该会办事处（华界福州路117号）举行会议，并通过以下决议：-

1) 指派两名代表与公司资方谈判，要求将撤回运营的驳船数量从15艘减为10艘。

2) 如果谈判失败，则召开进一步会议。

鸿兴昌铁厂 - 劳工局势

位于乌尔嘎路（Urga Road，即今蒙古路）150号的鸿兴昌（Hong Shing Chong）铁厂的19名工人，为抗议资方引入新规定（规定增加工作时间并对疏忽职守的工人施加惩罚）（参见 I.R.20/6/36），于6月17日停止作业，截至6月26日上午仍处于停工状态。

社会局已于6月25日指示该铁厂资方于6月26日上午10时赴该局参加会议，讨论局势。

The Chinese Chamber of Commerce will hold its annual
meeting at 2 p.m. to-day, June 20 in the Chamber's building,
North Soochow Road. During the proceedings, an election
of members to fill vacancies on the Executive and Supervisory
Committees for the ensuing year will be held.

Workers of the Hong Shing Chong Iron Foundry, 150 Urga Road,
suspend operations

The nineteen workers of the Hong Shing Chong Iron
Foundry, 150 Urga Road, suspended operations on June 17
as a protest against the introduction by the management of
new regulations which include an increase in the working
hours and the infliction of punishment on workers for
neglect of duty. These workers are still out this morning,
June 20 and work in the foundry is being carried out by
15 apprentices. The regulations in question, containing
29 clauses, have been approved by the Bureau of Social Affairs.

In furtherance of the New Life Movement, the personnel
of the local Kuomintang Headquarters, on June 19, formed a
New Life Movement Labour Service Group (新生活勞動服務團),
with Wu Kai-sien (吳開先) and Loh Ching-dz (陸京士),
committee members of the Tangpu, as the Chairman and Vice
Chairman.

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Cessation of work by Iron Foundry workers employed at the Hong Shing Tsong Iron Foundry, 150 Urga Road.

At 3.00 p.m. 18/6/36, C.P.S.823 whilst on patrol learned through the medium of C.P...2268 employed at the Hong Shin Tsong Iron Foundry, 150 Urga Road that 19 iron foundry workers employed in the above mentioned Foundry had ceased work at about 7 a.m. 17/6/36.

On receipt of the above information, the undersigned accompanied by C.D.S.10 proceeded to the Hong Shing Tsong Iron Foundry, 150 Urga Road where it was learned that the 19 iron foundry workers employed in the above foundry had ceased work at 7 a.m. 17/6/36.

It was learned from Mr. Hong Nyi Shing (项義兴) proprietor of the Foundry that during May 1936 he had compiled 29 Foundry Regulations, and submitted them to the Bureau of Social Affairs, for approval, and on 3/6/36 he received a reply from the Bureau of Social Affairs to the effect that they had approved the 29 Foundry Regulations submitted, and that the Regulations could be taken into effect immediately.

Mohammedan Association to celebrate the birthday of
Mohammed
In celebration of the birthday of Mohammed, members
of the Shanghai Mohammedan Association will hold a general
meeting in their office at 222 Tsing Lien Ka, City, at
11 a.m. June 3, 1936. Arrangements are also being made
to charter an aeroplane from the China Aviation Society
to distribute handbills bearing on the occasion.

Labour
Patons & Baldwins, Ltd. - suspend operations
Patons & Baldwins, Ltd., woollen and worsted yarn
spinners, 400 Poyang Road, suspended operations for one
week commencing on June 1 in order that repairs may be
made to the machinery. The company employs 401 workers.

Ircn.Foundry Workers - labour situation
About 200 out of the 2,000 ircn foundry workers in
Shanghai are still on strike this morning, June 2, although
all foundries are operating.
Forty-two members of the Iron Foundry Owners' Association
at a meeting held in their office at 16 Siking Road, at 4
p.m. June 1, 1936, decided to persist in the decision not
to agree to the demand of the workers that wages be paid
for the period of the recent strike. The usual dates for the
issue of wages are the 2nd and 16th of each month.
